name: Shifting Mire
summary: In the Swamp of Sorrows, the Shifting Mire spreads west of the Pool of Tears. Beneath its murky water, strange silt drifts and gathers under an unseen force.

sections.title: A Living Bog
sections.body: The Shifting Mire covers the swamp’s central reaches, where firm ground is scarce. Along the bog floor, fine silt shifts and gathers under a strange energy in the peat. Predators prowl the drifting mud: swamp jaguars, massive sorrow spinners, and hungry sawtooth crocolisks. Bands of broken draenei called the Lost Ones stalk the sunken paths.

faq.q: Why is it called the Shifting Mire?
faq.answer: Fine silt gives the Shifting Mire its name. A mysterious current of energy makes the mud gather, drift, and flow across the wetlands instead of settling.

faq.q: What creatures live in the Shifting Mire?
faq.answer: Sawtooth crocolisks lurk in the shallows, while giant sorrow spinners weave webs in the boughs. Swamp jaguars pass unseen through the mire, and roaming Lost Ones frequent the area. The Lost Ones are draenei warped and exiled from their homeworld.

faq.q: Where is the Shifting Mire located?
faq.answer: The Shifting Mire covers the central expanse of the Swamp of Sorrows, directly west of the Pool of Tears.

angles.text: As a hunter, track carefully through tangled brush and drifting water. Stay alert for stealthy swamp jaguars and venomous sorrow spinners hidden in the foliage.
